tools.name: find_subdomains
tools.description: List the hostnames found under a domain in TLS certificates: one row per hostname with the number of certificates and first/last seen dates. Covers certificates valid now or expired within the last 90 days; set history to true for every hostname certified since 2013 (needs an API key on the Pro Lite

tools.name: get_ca
tools.description: Return one issuing CA certificate by its SHA-256 fingerprint (the issuer_ca field of get_certificate): subject, issuer, validity, parent and cross-signed certificates, the number of certificates it issued and a page of them.

tools.name: get_certificate
tools.description: Return the full record of one certificate: subject, issuer, serial number, validity, DNS names, key and signature details, the CT log entries that recorded it and download URLs for the certificate body. id is the id field of a search result or the certificate's SHA-256 fingerprint (64 hex characters

tools.name: search_certificates
tools.description: List TLS certificates issued for a domain name: id, matching names, issuer, serial number and validity dates. By default matches the exact name; set include_subdomains to true to also match every name under it. Covers certificates valid now or expired within the last 90 days unless archive is set to

tools.name: search_organization
tools.description: List TLS certificates whose subject organization matches a name, e.g. "PayPal, Inc.": id, subject common name, domains, issuer and validity dates. Covers certificates valid now or expired within the last 90 days unless archive is set to "full" or a year from 2013 (needs an API key on the Pro plan).

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "find_subdomains" appears informational but accepts parameters (history) that enable code/file/secret access.
